# SKILL BHARAT Education

> Official website: https://bharatskill48-sketch.github.io/skill-bharat-education/

SKILL BHARAT Education is an online vocational learning and student-services platform. Its website provides trade-wise learning resources, student registration and login, online admission applications, study materials, a student dashboard, digital student ID card features, certificate application and certificate ID search/verification.

## Learning areas
- Electrician: electrical theory, safety and practical skills.
- AC Technician: air-conditioning and refrigeration basics.
- Computer Science / IT: computer fundamentals, software and programming.
- Mobile Repairing: mobile hardware, tools and troubleshooting.
- General Trade & Employability: workshop safety, tools and job readiness.
- Plumbing: introductory plumbing learning resources.

## Student services
- Student registration and login.
- Online admission applications.
- Trade-wise study materials and learning notes.
- Student dashboard and digital student ID card features.
- Certificate application, subject to administrator review.
- Certificate ID search and verification.
